vb_textbox.text: Its a simple and complicated game, but do not worry; I GAT YOU!First of all, there are 2 basket colours: Red and Yellow. There are 2 categories of gnomes; The Red based Gnomes and the yellow based Gnomes.The red based Gnomes are: RED, PINK, PURPLE AND BROWNThe Yellow based gnomes are : YELLOW, GREEN BLUE AND ORANGEThe secret is to match the red based gnomes to the red basket and vice versa.I will also advice you to stick to patterns that you notice give you the highest numbers of mushrooms.Have FUN.
